system.description: Humans are social beings that tend to be central in the development of major, diverse melting pot civilizations. Their tendency to develop wide, sprawling empires and a huge pool of cultures makes them extremely adaptable adventurers.

traits.name: Aptitude
traits.description: You gain a Perk and a Training.

traits.name: Strong Potential
traits.description: Increase one of your Stats by 1, but no higher than 7.
